label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is a True Positive. The sink expression at line 22 writes the variable 'corr' directly to the HTTP response body ('text/html'). The variable 'corr' is assigned from 'request.getHeader("X-Correlation-Id")', but critically, if that header is null, it falls back to 'param' (line 21), which originates from 'request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest")'. Since 'param' is user-controlled input and flows to the sink without HTML encoding or sanitization, an attacker can inject malicious scripts via the 'BenchmarkTest' parameter when the header is omitted.

evidence.note: Data flow: corr assigned from header or param (L20-L21), then printed to response writer (L22) without encoding.
